title: Sheet Pan Chicken Thighs with Potatoes
description: Bone-in chicken thighs roasted on a sheet pan until the skin shatters and the potatoes crisp in the rendered fat. The hot arugula-and-lemon finish cuts through the richness and makes this feel like more than the sum of its parts.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels — this is non-negotiable for crispy skin. Season generously on both sides with smoked paprika, garlic powder, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper.
Toss halved potatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper on a rimmed sheet pan. Spread them toward the edges of the pan, cut-side down.
Nestle chicken thighs skin-side up among the potatoes. Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil over the chicken skin.
Roast until the chicken skin is deeply golden and crisp and the potatoes are fork-tender, 35 to 40 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a thigh should read 165°F.
Scatter arugula over the hot pan — it will wilt slightly from the residual heat. Squeeze lemon wedges over everything and finish with flaky salt.

inspirations.author: Melissa Clark
inspirations.note: Inspired by her sheet pan chicken recipes and one-pan dinner philosophy
